info.description: The Catalog Management API allows users to create detailed entries for Covellit Pendants in the merchandise catalog. This operation supports the onboarding of new products by enabling businesses to enrich their catalogs with detailed specifications, pricing, and imagery. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require seamless integration of new product details. By utilizing this API, companies can enhance user shopping experiences by ensuring accurate and comprehensive product data.
